title: Head bounds for the combined configuration
statement: Let $B\in\mathbb{Z}$, and form a configuration with $2k$ work tapes by concatenating the contents and head positions of two $k$-tape collections, with any state, input-head position, and output. If every head position in each collection has absolute value at most $B$, then every work-tape head position in the combined configuration has absolute value at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: Every head position in the first collection has absolute value at most B
Every head position in the second collection has absolute value at most B
